works.title: Personal Prompt Engineering Architecture System
works.description: A multi-component methodological framework for AI-assisted prompting combining prompt cleanup, RAG provenance rating, belief-architecture tagging (axioms/hypotheses/credence), relationship typing for outline organization, and thinking-framework integration. The user is designing systems for tagged information retrieval, paradigm-level commitment tracking, and comprehension-testing through relationship labeling.
works.quote: I'll ultimately develop to help formalize my concepts: an analysis algorithm that organizes these outlines and makes the relationship between main bullet points and subheadings explicit

works.title: Atticus Book
works.description: A text-based book in active production and formatting using Atticus publishing software. The user is actively working through detailed typography and layout decisions including font size optimization (currently 10-point Garamond, too small), line spacing, margins, headers/footers, widows/orphans control, and table of contents structure for readability.
works.quote: I just got my book back today, and the text looks very small. Atticus recommends and defaults to a 10-point font.
